notes.title: V1.00202209172000 update
notes.notes:
1. Modified the position of the confirmation and cancel keys of the controller. Sorry for the inconvenience!
2. The controller key names are now the same as the XBOX controller key.
3. Fixed the wrong performance of some BOSS on some computer configurations.
4. More kinds of window sizes are supported in the Options.
5. Fixed some wrong play logic of some sound effects.
6. More keyboard keys are now be supported as custom keys.
7. Fixed the wrong performance when No.02 launching a shooting ExAttack on a wall.
8: Fixed some wrong character state.

notes.title: Super Alloy Ranger will release on Steam on September 14
notes.notes:
Super Alloy Ranger will release on Steam on September 14, 19:00 (PST). The launch trailer will be aired at the Tokyo Game Show, which opens on the same day.

As one of the player's concerns, the game will provide players with a variety of difficulty options. Normal difficulty has removed part of the instant death mechanism, and reduces the damage of enemies, more suitable for players who attach importance to the plot and collection. Meantime, crazy difficulty is more suitable for players who like to challenge themselves. We hope that all kinds of players can find fun in this game.
